<%*
// New card in Work (where/work).
// GENERATED by scripts/generate-card-templates.mjs — do not edit by hand.
const title = await tp.system.prompt("Card title");
if (!title) { new Notice("Card creation cancelled — no title given."); return; }
const slug = title.toLowerCase().normalize("NFKD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
await tp.file.move(`/where/work/${slug}/index`);
-%>
---
title: <% JSON.stringify(title) %>
status: draft
date: <% tp.date.now("YYYY-MM-DD") %>
tags: []
# Optional fields for this folder — uncomment the ones you need.
# description:  # string
# priority:     # number
# playable:     # always | never
# viewable:     # always | never
# buyable:      # always | never
# inspected:    # true | false
# image:        # string
# when:         # string
# roles:        # string
---

<% tp.file.cursor() %>
